problems.problem: Bottle appears to float above the floor due to shadow offset_y=0 (no contact shadow), violating deterministic geometry where product_base_y=1245 should align with floor contact. Visible shadow is detached, not anchored to the bottle's base.
Bottle height (850px) occupies 59% of canvas (1440px), slightly exceeding the 50-65% range for a single-bottle hero, creating an unbalanced vertical hierarchy.
Shadow blur=10 is excessive for a contact shadow, reducing realism and integration with the floor.
Title '香氛' (size 62) and subtitle 'EAU DE PARFUM' (size 22) lack visual hierarchy; the subtitle's smaller size and lighter weight fail to complement the title, weakening brand messaging.
Generic dramatic backdrop (wine-red wall/floor) lacks the conceptual depth of references (e.g., Tom Ford's fig imagery, Byredo's abstract red form), resulting in a disconnected visual narrative.

changes.value: Deep wine-red painted plaster wall meeting a continuous matte red floor, close-up studio interior, single strong diagonal shadow cast across wall from a high window, dark burgundy material spanning every horizontal and vertical edge, smooth clean center and lower foreground, realistic physical studio environment photograph with subtle texture variation in the floor to emphasize contact
